research_plan: The user is asking for the current gold rate in Chennai today. I need to search for live market data regarding gold prices in Chennai for 22k and 24k gold.
analyst_draft_answer: As of September 26, 2026, the live market rates for gold in Chennai reflect slight downward adjustments compared to previous trading days [C1], [C2]. According to prominent bullion and retail tracking sources including LiveChennai and GoodReturns, the standard 24-karat gold (99.9% purity) is priced at ₹15,273 per gram, representing a minor decrease of ₹11 from the preceding day [C1], [C2]. On a bulk scale, 24K gold is valued at ₹1,22,184 for 8 grams (equivalent to a South Indian sovereign or pavan) and ₹1,52,730 for 10 grams [C1], [C2]. Meanwhile, 22-karat gold (91.6% purity), which is heavily favored across Tamil Nadu for traditional ornaments and daily-wear jewelry due to its enhanced structural durability, stands at ₹14,000 per gram after dropping by ₹10 [C1], [C2]. The 22K gold rate translates to ₹1,12,000 for an 8-gram sovereign and ₹1,40,000 for 10 grams [C1], [C2]. Additionally, 18-karat gold (75% purity), commonly utilized in lightweight or diamond-studded western jewelry designs, is trading at ₹11,770 per gram (₹94,160 for 8 grams and ₹1,17,700 for 10 grams) [C2]. These base metal quotations serve as essential benchmarks for local investors, retail buyers, and families planning purchases for weddings or seasonal festivities [C1]. It is important for consumers to note that these figures represent base bullion prices only and do not incorporate statutory levies such as the 3% Goods and Services Tax (GST), Tax Collected at Source (TCS), or individual jeweler making charges, which typically range between 8% and 25% depending on craftsmanship complexity [C2], [C3]. When cross-referencing alternative feeds like LivePriceofGold, minor discrepancies in spot calculations can appear due to differing feed aggregation times or localized conversion premiums, though major retail associations in Chennai consistently align around the ₹14,000 (22K) and ₹15,273 (24K) baseline per gram [C1], [C2], [C5].
